UNDERSTANDING AREA
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what understanding area means in plain words.
• Give one clear example linked to Area.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
Understanding Area. Get clear on area before moving on. How would you explain area to a classmate in one minute? Use this anchor: Calculate the area of a pentagon and a hexagon in different situations. Clue from the topic: Outs to work out the area of pentagon and hexagon. Check every example on this page against that anchor.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Measurement problems need a formula, correct units, and careful substitution.
• Perimeter is the distance around a shape. Area is the surface covered. Volume/capacity is space inside.
• Example lengths for this page: 8 cm and 4 cm.
• Write units in the final answer (cm, m, cm², m², litres).
• Sketch the figure and label sides before calculating.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
Worked example on Area:
A square garden has side 6 m. Find the area.

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6
3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
